svg.title: one gateway port and a VLAN switch, in network namespaces
svg.desc: tests/host/test_enforcement_vlan.sh: a VLAN-filtering bridge plays the switch, vlan-setup.sh and the ruleset run unchanged in the gateway namespace. It checks admission and quarantine, the ways around a VLAN, and two known limits, which behave as stated.

g.text: Only the quote port; the gateway can attest it.
To the LAN through the gateway; a second, unattested endpoint still cannot.
A LAN address, self-tagged frames, LAN to endpoint: all blocked.
Same-VLAN endpoints see each other; a taken address passes until the next cycle.
